question_text: Explain why matching LOAN.MemberID to MEMBER.MemberID is useful when retrieving a borrower’s outstanding items.
adaptation_rationale: Retains record-matching reasoning only as an explicit relational key/relationship application; no general data-matching taxonomy.
solution: The shared identifier links each loan to the correct member record. Staff can combine member details with related items instead of matching ambiguous names manually, reducing mistaken notices to the wrong person.

marking_points.criterion: Explains avoided ambiguity/error or useful retrieval.
